alternatives_named: defer self-hostable CI until runtime adapters exist
add one Jenkinsfile per microservice with a package group
F6_alternatives.selected_rationale: One Jenkinsfile per microservice follows ADR-0349 and the existing repo pattern while the package group covers the domain/app/API crates introduced so far.
rejected_reasons: Deferring CI would leave the enterprise foundations without a self-hostable gate surface before cloud integration.
One Jenkinsfile per crate would drift from the repository's microservice-level Jenkins convention and multiply maintenance surfaces.

M1_challenge_assumption.premise_stated: Self-hostable CI is useful before runtime deployment only if it gates the current package and contract surfaces without implying production deployment.
M1_challenge_assumption.do_nothing_consequence: Cloud integration work could add deploy adapters before self-hosted CI parity exists, creating a late CI/CD retrofit risk.
M1_challenge_assumption.upstream_fix_rejection_reason: Waiting for global Wave 15-ZE rollout would not protect these ahead-of-time enterprise slices during continued local development.
